objective: Run the complete eight-device, two-drain-voltage, 51-gate-point SimpleMOS matrix with Sentaurus DirectCurrent as the only intervention, quantify its effect on Vela-Sentaurus Id-Vg agreement and the matched NWell trend, and preserve the original-deck default matrix as an immutable baseline.

upstream.m52_state_invariance_scope: n19 and n23 at Vd=0.05 V and Vg=0.00, 0.05, and 0.10 V

diagnostic_replay.input_tdrs: exact copies from the frozen M8 Sentaurus bundle
diagnostic_replay.deck_rule: insert only DirectCurrent in the global Math section; no CurrentWeighting, Plot, CurrentPlot Tcl, physics, mesh, electrode, solve-path, or bias change

analysis.terminal_replay: compare all source, drain, gate, and substrate electron, hole, and total currents against the 72 frozen M52 DirectCurrent terminal rows at the six shared states
analysis.nwell_metric: for every matched pair and drain voltage, compare the high-minus-low maximum absolute log-error amplification under default and DirectCurrent observations

classifications.direct_reduces_global_and_nwell_amplific: the global maximum log error decreases and DirectCurrent does not increase the high-minus-low maximum-error amplification in any matched NWell pair
classifications.direct_reduces_global_partial_nwell: the global maximum log error decreases but at least one matched NWell pair has larger high-minus-low amplification
classifications.direct_global_error_unchanged: the global maximum log error is unchanged within the frozen comparison tolerance
classifications.direct_increases_global_error: the global maximum log error increases
classifications.terminal_replay_mismatch: one or more of the 72 shared M52 terminal-component anchors does not replay within tolerance
classifications.replay_incomplete: the required curve, point, bias, or terminal matrix is incomplete

analysis.claim_guard: M53 evaluates a diagnostic observation algorithm. The original official-deck default remains the primary compatibility baseline, and no result authorizes changing Vela or Sentaurus production defaults.

forbidden_work: BGN, SRH, mobility, contact model, mesh, electrode, solve-path, or production-default changes
adding HeteroInterface, Thermionic, or Discontinuity physics
rewriting M8, M45 through M52, or M46 baseline artifacts
deliverables: regression test for contract and evidence invariants
